label: Stained Glass
intent: Luminous symbolism, collective structure, and strong long-distance recognition
path_treatment: Use expressive lead lines and a continuous luminous glass band to carry the eye.
form_treatment: Abstract subjects into distinct translucent fields while retaining key color and relationship anchors.
space_treatment: Replace realistic depth with quiet glass fields, transmitted light, and structural segmentation.
composition: Bold symbolic silhouette organized by lead lines; one luminous focal axis or shared center.
